title: Append-only write-back routing record
description: One finding returned by a consuming project. This record says WHERE the knowledge was incorporated; it is deliberately not a place to store the knowledge itself. A row whose incorporated_in is empty is an open loop, and is meant to be visible as one.

source_project.description: The consuming project that found it. The package has no other record of provenance.

finding.description: One sentence naming what was learned. A pointer, not the content: the content belongs in the file named by incorporated_in.

incorporated_in.description: Repo-relative paths that now carry the knowledge. Empty only when status is open.
